changelog: A published channel now lists its schedule instead of just the one program on air: opening a channel shows what is running and what follows, in order, with start times. Every entry is playable - the one on air joins live, a later one starts from its beginning.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
